cover.report_type: Interim Report: June 17 (for the period ending June 18, 2008 as printed)

_meta.notes: Neither amendment box is checked; only the June 17 interim box. Filed on a 2008-vintage form (footer '08_FinancialDisclosureform.doc') whose printed period labels all say 2008; the filer hand-corrected 'ending June 16' to '18'. Signed 6/19/2012; Summary Page 'Date of Report' reads 6/18/2012; Column B is headed 'Sum Total to Date'. The cover and Summary Page are identical to those of the file the clerk labels the June amendment (key 13bf3106) — worth a human's eye, since one of the two is a duplicate rather than a correction.

contributions.detail: exact (83,204.50 = 83,204.50); 132 rows across the 8 landscape Schedule A pages summed against the printed 'Total Contributions Received' on p10, which equals Summary Page line 1

expenditures.detail: exact (86,115.04 = 86,115.04); 119 rows across the 3 portrait Schedule B pages summed against the printed 'Total Expenditutres Made' [sic] on p13, which equals Summary Page line 2

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO page-level subtotal exists on either schedule in this filing - the spreadsheet prints only a grand total at the end of each side. Both grand totals gated EXACTLY (A p10 83,204.50 = 132 rows; B p13 86,115.04 = 119 rows), which validates the amount column of every row collectively.
itemized.escalation_note: Rotation sign resolved by test render: pages 3-10 needed -90 (CW); a +90 render came out upside down. This is the OPPOSITE sign from the McAdams filing in the same chunk - the sign is per file. No digit-level escalation was needed: both sides closed to the cent on the first read.
itemized.notes: Pages: 1 cover, 2 Summary Page, 3-10 Schedule A (landscape, 8 pages, no page subtotals, grand total on p10), 11-13 Schedule B (portrait, 3 pages, no page subtotals, grand total on p13). PRIVACY: the Address column is county-redacted with a solid black bar on every Schedule A page; City and State were read from their own separate columns. Verbatim oddities retained, never corrected: Waste Management's STATE is printed 'TV' (row 6/11/12, Houston - evidently a typo for TX); contributor names 'Waste Manaement', 'Momument Arts', 'Daning Moose Montessori School', 'Staybrigdge Suites', 'Queststar Gas', 'Toco Bell', 'Fort Heriman Days', and the Schedule B heading 'Total Expenditutres Made' are all as printed. Twelve Schedule B rows print the purpose truncated at the cell edge as 'Donation for Golf Tournamen' - kept verbatim, never completed. The golf-tournament in-kind items appear on BOTH schedules (as in-kind contributions on p6-p7 and as in-kind expenditures on p13); that is the filer's own treatment and both sides' printed totals close exactly with them included. The clerk listing labels this a June interim; the transcription is from the form as filed.
